preview_en:
Croatia are under new management for the first time in nearly a decade as they begin their UEFA Nations League (UNL) campaign against a Czech Republic side returning to the top tier of this competition.

Match News and Current Form

Czech Republic are also led by a new manager, with Miroslav Koubek axed after a disappointing showing at the World Cup which saw them exit at the group stage having scored just twice (D1, L2). Santi Denia takes the hot seat having lost leading striker Patrik Schick to international retirement, which will make the challenge of competing in League A even harder. The Czechs were relegated in their previous appearance at this level only to return thanks to promotion in 2024/25, and they’ll be grateful to get going on home soil where they’ve not been beaten since September 2022 (W16, D2)!

Zlatko Dalić, the most successful and longest-serving coach in Croatia’s history, ended his nine-year reign after the World Cup which saw his side eliminated in the Round of 32 against Portugal thanks to an extremely late and controversial goal. After a two-year touchline absence, Slaven Bilić assumes control of a side competing at the top tier of the UNL for a fifth successive cycle, the last two of which have seen them progress beyond the initial group phase. Runners-up in 2022/23, Croatia may struggle for a good start here as while they’re unbeaten in their last four away games (W3, D1), they failed to win the four prior (D1, L3) which represented all four trips in the previous UNL cycle!

Head-to-Head History

Croatia are unbeaten across all six prior H2Hs (W3, D3), though three of the last four ended level. Their only previous away game against Czech Republic was drawn 0-0 in October 2025 during World Cup qualifying.

Hot Stats and Streaks

Six of Czech Republic’s last seven games saw both teams score.

Six of Czech Republic’s last seven competitive home internationals featured over 10.5 corners.

Seven of Croatia’s last 11 matches produced an odd number of goals.

Four of Croatia’s last five defeats came by a two-goal margin.

Key Players to Watch and Missing Players

Adam Hložek is the joint-top scoring forward in the Czech squad (G5), with his last two international goals, as well as one of his two strikes for Hoffenheim this term, arriving before half-time in wins. An aging Croatia squad is still led by 41-year-old Luka Modrić and 37-year-old Ivan Perišić , who boast four goals against Czech Republic between them across the last four H2Hs.

Czech Republic’s top active scorer Tomáš Souček is sidelined by injury, while Croatia appear to have no fresh injury concerns.

Betting Analysis

A fast start is imperative in a group which contains England and Spain, and given their home form, Czech Republic to win looks well priced.

Author: Ryan Fisher
